hand_ups.corrected_rule_verbatim: A pin shorter than 12 hex is REFUSED as a mismatch - ``_same_digest`` requires ``width >= 12``, so it cannot be compared at all (fail-closed, not a "reduced strength" match, and with no ``PIN ABBREVIATED`` note).  A pin of 12-63 hex that matches is ACCEPTED and reported loudly (``PIN ABBREVIATED`` run note + ``REDUCED STRENGTH`` clause in the shared graph line).  A pin of exactly 64 hex that matches is accepted silently.  A pin longer than 64 hex is REFUSED (``PIN OVERLONG``) - a sha256 is exactly 64 hex, so a longer value is a corrupted or mis-edited pin whose tail must never be blessed.  A re-pin must write the FULL 64-hex sha256 (``_graph_digest``'s value; the 12-hex form is display-only).
